seo.title: 3-Day Desert Tour from Fes to Marrakech | Erg Chebbi & Atlas (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €310 pp. 3-day desert tour from Fes to Marrakech via Merzouga (private or shared). Middle Atlas cedar forest, Erg Chebbi camel trek, Ait Ben Haddou & local guide.
seo.lead: A 3-day private point-to-point desert journey connecting the imperial medina of Fes to the vibrant souks of Marrakech. The route crosses the Middle Atlas cedar forests, traverses the dramatic Ziz Gorge, includes an overnight desert bivouac in the golden Erg Chebbi dunes of Merzouga, and continues past Todra Gorges and Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou over the High Atlas Mountains.

price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned transport, licensed multilingual Berber driver-guide, 1 night in an Erg Chebbi desert bivouac, 1 night in a boutique Dades Valley riad, sunset camel trek, dinners, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Camel caravan traversing the golden sand dunes of Erg Chebbi on a 3-day desert tour from Fes to Marrakech
highlights: Cross the Middle Atlas Mountains with stops in Ifrane and the ancient Azrou cedar forest
Observe wild Barbary macaques in their native cedar woodland habitat
Travel along the sweeping palm oases of the Ziz Valley and canyon gorges
Sunset and sunrise camel trek across the monumental Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga
Overnight in a private Sahara desert camp with traditional tagines and Berber drum music around the fire
Walk beneath the 300-meter cliffs of Todra Gorges and explore UNESCO Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou

faqs.question: Is this a direct point-to-point tour between Fes and Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. This tour begins with pickup at your riad or hotel in Fes on Day 1 and finishes with drop-off at your accommodation in Marrakech on Day 3, eliminating the need to backtrack across Morocco.

faqs.question: What is the driving duration between Fes and the Merzouga desert on Day 1?
faqs.answer: Day 1 covers approximately 470 km (roughly 7.5 to 8 hours total). The journey is broken into comfortable legs with stops in alpine Ifrane, the Azrou monkey forest, lunch in Midelt, and a panoramic viewpoint over the Ziz Valley before reaching Merzouga for the late afternoon camel trek.

faqs.question: What happens to my heavy luggage during the camel ride to the camp?
faqs.answer: Your large suitcases and heavy bags stay securely locked inside your private transport vehicle or are transferred directly to camp via 4x4 support. You only need a small daypack with your overnight clothing and camera essentials.

faqs.question: What tent amenities are provided at the Merzouga desert camp?
faqs.answer: Standard camps provide private furnished Berber tents with shared bathroom facilities. Luxury camp upgrades include spacious private canvas suites with plush bedding, private ensuite hot showers, flush toilets, and electrical charging outlets.

faqs.question: Are special dietary requirements catered for during the tour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free dietary preferences are fully accommodated throughout all riad dinners and desert camp meals. Please notify us of any dietary needs during reservation.
